disabledTrace.scope: Artifact-free upstream base-runner control; candidate default failure documents separately asserted. Public steps, outcomes, explicit attachments and stdio match; candidate journal remains empty.

limits: Focused source and packed acceptance only; broader merged core gate remains pending.
Fallback covers one main document. Rendered child-frame composition is explicitly omitted with an optional diagnostic. Public ARIA modes remain separately gated.

Failure document256KiB,16 errors,32768 UTF-16-unit fields/stacks,1024 stack lines; source8MiB and64KiB retained window. Fallback16384 UTF-16 units includes its truncation marker. These are retained/output limits, not browser CPU bounds.
Original attempt owns fallback and publication through hook teardown, late creation, retry and optional capture errors. Expected failures publish documents; successful attempts do not.
Native Linux remains unverified. No performance or release claim; the frozen70dc299f broad benchmark predates default failure-document work.
Raw runner documents, traces, screenshots, reports and watchdog records remain private; exact hashes bind this portable focused receipt.
